Accurate Isosurface Interpolation with Hermite Data
In this work we study the interpolation problem in contouring methods such as Marching Cubes. Traditionally, linear interpolation is used to define the position of an is vertex along a zero-crossing edge, which is a suitable approach if the underlying implicit function is (approximately) piecewise linear along each edge.
